reviews.body:
### 🔵 Needs a closer look The new escape form has only been validated against the language decoder, so a live Kusto round-trip is still needed to verify data preservation for inline strings and query parameters. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR This PR fixes Unicode escaping in the SDK’s KQL string serialization, preventing characters above U+FFFF, such as emoji, from being altered in string literals and query parameters. **Changes:** - Use eight-digit `\U` escapes for supplementary code points while preserving existing output for other characters. - Add regression tests for Unicode boundaries, emoji, `AddString`, and string query parameters. - Document the fix in the unreleased changelog. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `CHANGELOG.md` | Documents the corrected Unicode escaping behavior. | | `azkustodata/​kql/​string_utils.go` | Emits eight-digit escapes for code points above U+FFFF. | | `azkustodata/​kql/​string_utils_test.go` | Covers Unicode boundaries and both string serialization entry points. |
Review effort: Max
